description:
Leave a 1–5 star peer rating for a counterparty after a completed escrow.

Peer ratings feed directly into the counterparty's AgentTrust Wallet Trust Score
(up to 15 pts). One rating per escrow per rater. Ratings are permanent and public.

Proof required: provide rater_signature + rater_public_key + signature_ts (signed locally
with xrpl.core.keypairs.sign), or use an enterprise x-api-key linked to rater_address.

comment.description: Optional short comment about the counterparty (max 280 chars).

escrow_id.description: The escrow ID for the completed transaction. One rating allowed per escrow per rater.
escrow_id.title: Escrow ID

rater_address.description: Your XRPL wallet address (r...) — the rater.
rater_address.title: Your Wallet Address

rater_public_key.description: Hex public key whose derived address == rater_address.

rater_role.description: Your role in the escrow: 'buyer' or 'worker'.
rater_role.title: Your Role

rater_signature.description: Hex signature over 'agenttrust-rate:{escrow_id}:{rated}:{rating}:{ts}' from rater_address private key.

signature_ts.description: Unix timestamp used when signing (must be within 5 min of now).
signature_ts.title: Signature Timestamp

wallet_address.description: The XRPL wallet address (r...) of the counterparty you are rating.
wallet_address.title: Wallet to Rate

name: rate_wallet
title: Rate Counterparty
